description: Performance budgets for scripts/loadtest.ts (WP-1 of PLAN-ARCHITECTURE-AS-CODE-COMPLIANCE). The full profile carries the ADL targets (capabilities.adl: >=1000 stores/s flat to 20000 memories, recall p95 <150ms, TF-IDF); the smoke profile is the PR-gate variant at reduced scale. tolerance widens the pass band for runner noise: rate passes at >= min/tolerance, p95 at <= max*tolerance.

calibration.status: provisional — floors set with very large headroom from the recorded reference run (2026-07-30, 20k memories, TF-IDF: ADD ~2200/s, SEARCH p95 93ms, DELETE 79/s I/O-bound). Recalibrate on the CI runner before tightening any number; until then a miss means something is deeply wrong, not marginally slow.
calibration.machine: local workstation (maintainer); CI-runner calibration pending — see PLAN-ARCHITECTURE-AS-CODE-COMPLIANCE.md WP-1
